landman2024_vsini.note: CRIRES+ spin rotation of beta Pic b. The paper also gives a period of 8.7 ± 0.8 h assuming no obliquity.

snellen2014_vsini.note: First measurement (Nature 509, 63). Superseded by the more recent value above, shown for comparison only.

schwarz2016_vsini.note: A slow rotator at the age of 5 Myr.

bryan2021_incl.note: Line-of-sight inclination of the spin axis from v sin i and a published photometric period. The paper gives 14° ± 4° or, equivalently for the Doppler effect, 166° ± 4°.

zhang2024_vsini_b.note: VLT/CRIRES+. ADS drops the symbol of the quantity from this sentence; the abstract names it 'rotation velocities' and discusses 'different spin axis inclinations', so it is the projected velocity.

zhou2020_period.note: Spitzer/IRAC light curve of VHS 1256-1257 b.

poon2024_incl.note: From IGRINS v sin i (value not readable in the ADS abstract) and the photometric period.
